reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the deliverable matches: the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports the compliance call: PB's payments under Article 6 are consideration for the Trial Data Package, arise only on Regulatory Approval, and are scaled pro rata to Development Costs actually paid/incurred by SFJ with an express true-up mechanic (p0521) rather than a shortfall penalty — i.e., usage/success-based rather than take-or-pay.

An exit exists (Section 14.2.2 at-will termination before first Regulatory Approval, plus Section 6.7 buy-out options), so the arrangement is not the walk-away 'multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right'.

The rationale correctly treats the $110M–$120M Elected Total Amount floor and the 'spend at least the amount SFJ funds' covenant as sub-elements noted rather than deviations: they are a minimum draw of the counterparty's funding and a use-of-proceeds/diligence covenant, not a minimum purchase obligation running to the counterparty.
Appropriately avoids double-flagging the 300% termination payment and buy-out economics, which belong to the termination/liquidated-damages rules.
